crossRefs.note: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit…
He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and…
She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field…
Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not…
By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
“Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for…

translations.web: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
translations.bsb: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
